entities.name: Delphi method
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: The Delphi method, or Delphi technique, is a structured communication technique, or method, originally developed as a systematic, interactive forecasting method that relies on a panel of experts. Delphi has been widely used for business forecasting and has certain advantages over another structured forecasting approach, prediction markets.
